authority: arcs-verify owns the C2PA independent-verification report and comparison contract. arcs-standard owns generic provenance-signal semantics; arcs-srs owns the native observation receipt serialization. This bundle claims neither.

excluded_from_pin.README.md: prose; changes here do not change machine semantics
excluded_from_pin.contract.manifest.json: prose; changes here do not change machine semantics

native_validator_pin.pin_rationale: The native validator version is a verdict input: the same bytes have been observed to validate differently across versions, and this crate published five patch versions inside forty-eight hours. Resolving 'latest' would make recomputation unreproducible.

scope_note: Pins only the machine semantic artifacts. Downstream consumers pin the SEMANTIC DIGEST described under semantic_pin — not the digest of this file, not the implementing commit, and not README bytes. A digest over this file's bytes would move whenever the prose fields below were edited, which is why no report carries one.

does_not_cover: the native validator binary itself (pinned by version, not vendored)
semantic_pin.note: The semantic digest identifies the machine contract this bundle publishes. It does not attest that any evaluation occurred, that any specimen is trusted, or that the pinned validator was actually run.
